g.text: CampusClaw Plan Mode - Complete Target Interaction
[Select plan when the new Session starts in build]
Session state remains running; mode remains plan.
The review tool waits. No business execution or TODO calls.
Approval transaction also commits mode=build and mode event.
After successful approval: implement in build
next item in_progress when starting it.
Disconnect: GET Events + GET Session for reconciliation; never replay accepted POST.
Interrupt: existing user.interrupt targets the current root and stops the execution.
The same Session spans clarification roots; approval resumes its original root.
